name: recoil_state_credits_register_at_exit
description: RecoilStateCredits::RegisterAtExit is the registered at-exit callback that destroys the global credits state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent RecoilStateCredits static-lifetime pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x409980 has no function/address warning tags and shows a tailcall to RecoilStateCredits::Destructor(&g_RecoilStateCredits).
RecoilStateCredits::Destructor is tier S under target recoil_state_credits_destructor.

The native static-init smoke calls RegisterAtExit directly with a live TestCreditsPanel dialog and verifies destructor side effects: base vtable restore, dialog clear, SetEnabled(0), and ScalarDeletingDestructor(1).
